name: Mitsubayashi Tsukasa
source: A cool, calculating person who seems to always have a cold grin on his face. Tsukasa prides himself in his antisocial status and treats relation as trades. To him, the only useful relations are those that’ll bring him benefit, emotion will only get in the way and should be discarded.When asked why he could be so calm under the circumstances, he only replied, “Because everything is under control.”
